name: assemblyExec
description: Execute shellcode in the current beacon using a thread, process, or spoofed-parent process mode. Donut inputs are prepared by the TeamServer shellcode service before the task is sent to the beacon.

args.name: path
args.description: Raw shellcode, .NET executable, or .NET DLL path on the TeamServer.

args.name: arguments
args.description: Arguments passed to the Donut source after --.

examples: assemblyExec --mode process --donut-dll Tool.dll --method EntryPoint -- arg1 arg2
